name: @pipeworx/mcp-airports

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Look up an airport by city name (e.g. "Tokyo", "New York", "London") OR by 3-letter IATA code (e.g. "JFK", "LHR"). City lookup uses a bundled map of the top ~150 international hubs; cities with multiple airports return all primary ones. For airports not in the bundle, pass an IATA code or use the aviationstack pack for full-text name/country search.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: Get airport details by IATA code (e.g., "JFK", "LHR"). Returns name, city, country, coordinates, altitude, timezone.

tools.name: calculate_distance
tools.description: Calculate straight-line distance between two airports by IATA code (e.g., "JFK" to "LHR"). Returns kilometers and miles.

from.description: IATA code of the origin airport (e.g. "JFK")

to.description: IATA code of the destination airport (e.g. "LHR")

tools.name: ourairports_lookup
tools.description: Look up ANY airfield in the OurAirports bulk dataset (~86,000 rows: every ICAO/IATA/local-code airport, heliport, seaplane base and balloonport OurAirports tracks, including fields with no IATA code at all). Pass ANY of: an ICAO code ("KJFK", "EGLL"), an IATA code ("JFK"), a GPS code, or OurAirports' own local/national ident (e.g. a US local code like "00A", or a non-US ident like "AT-0001"). Returns name, type (large_airport/medium_airport/small_airport/heliport/seaplane_base/balloonport/closed), coordinates, elevation, country/region, and whether it has scheduled airline service. This is the superset of get_airport's AirportGap data -- use this for any code AirportGap does not recognize, or for a heliport/seaplane base/ICAO-only field get_airport cannot see at all. An unrecognized code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

code.description: ICAO code ("KJFK"), IATA code ("JFK"), GPS code, or OurAirports local ident (e.g. "00A").

tools.name: airport_runways
tools.description: Runway details for one airfield from the OurAirports dataset: for each runway, length and width in feet, surface type, whether it is lighted, whether it is closed, and both ends' ident/coordinates/elevation/heading/displaced threshold. Pass any code ourairports_lookup accepts (ICAO, IATA, GPS or local ident). An airfield with no fixed-wing runways on file (e.g. most heliports) returns an empty runways array with found:true, not an error. An unrecognized airfield code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

tools.name: airport_frequencies
tools.description: Radio frequencies for one airfield from the OurAirports dataset: type (ATIS/TWR/GND/CLD/DIR/APP/DEP/CTAF/UNICOM/...), a human description, and the frequency in MHz. Pass any code ourairports_lookup accepts. An airfield with no frequencies on file returns an empty list with found:true, not an error. An unrecognized airfield code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

tools.name: airport_navaids
tools.description: Navigational aids (NDB, VOR, DME, VOR-DME, VORTAC, TACAN, ...) associated with one airfield from the OurAirports dataset: ident, name, type, frequency in kHz, coordinates, elevation, DME channel and power. Pass any code ourairports_lookup accepts. Most airfields have none on file (navaids are sparse relative to airports) -- that returns an empty list with found:true, not an error. An unrecognized airfield code is refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

tools.name: ourairports_search
tools.description: Search the OurAirports dataset (~86,000 airfields) by a text match against name, municipality or ident, optionally narrowed by ISO country code (e.g. "US", "GB") and/or airfield type ("large_airport", "medium_airport", "small_airport", "heliport", "seaplane_base", "balloonport", "closed"). Results default to airfields with scheduled airline service first. Use this to find airfields by partial name/city when you do not already have a code -- ourairports_lookup requires an exact code. Rows beyond `limit` are reported via truncated/total_matching rather than silently dropped -- narrow the query or page with limit/offset to see the rest. A query that matches nothing returns found:false with an explanation, never a silent empty array mistaken for "no such place".

query.description: Text to match against name, municipality or ident, e.g. "Heathrow" or "Bensalem".

country.description: Optional: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US", "GB", "FR".

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-100. Default 20. A truncated response carries truncated:true and total_matching.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-airports forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the airports pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
